subject: Intro: Redwood demo request — ShopStack self-serve
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@shopstack.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: Redwood demo request — ShopStack self-serve

Hi Avery,

I signed up for the self-serve tier last week and poked around the API. We're evaluating Redwood for two features: (1) dynamic product description generation for catalogue items and (2) conversational search in our merchant dashboard.

Rough traffic: ~3M monthly calls across descriptions + search, but it's spiky — peaks at ~450 qps during morning syncs. We're aiming to be production-ready in Q3 (August) and would like to see latency/cost tradeoffs and a brief walkthrough of Dedicated vs Hosted routing.

Could we schedule a short demo this week or next? Timezone: PDT (US-PST).

I've attached a small CSV with sample call patterns from our sandbox (anonymized).

Thanks,
Samira
Head of Platform, ShopStack
[Attachment: signup-export.csv (csv)]

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@shopstack.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo request — ShopStack self-serve

Thanks for the context, Samira — and welcome to Redwood! Quick set of clarifying questions so we tailor the session: 

- Primary goal today: latency profiling (P0) or cost/ops tradeoffs + rollout plan (P1)?
- Peak concurrency: is 450 qps a sustained 10–30s spike or sustained for minutes?
- Average token lengths for description generation vs. search (ballpark)?
- Are there regulatory constraints (PII or PCI scope) we should be aware of?
- Preferred demo length: 30 or 45 minutes?

Proposed times (PDT):
- Thu Apr 8, 10:00–10:30 AM
- Thu Apr 8, 2:00–2:45 PM
- Fri Apr 9, 9:00–9:30 AM

If none of these work, send 2–3 preferred windows and I'll match. I can include one of our Solutions Engineers (Marissa Cole) for the architecture section if you want to go deeper on Dedicated capacity sizing.

Attaching a short pre-demo checklist that helps speed the session.

Best,
Avery Johnson
SDR, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pre-demo-checklist.md (text)]

Thanks — answers below: 
- Primary goal: P1 (we need an ops-friendly rollout plan; latency is important but we can accept slightly higher tail if it saves cost).
- Spikes: usually 30–90s; occasional longer batch jobs overnight.
- Token length: descriptions avg ~40–60 tokens; search queries avg ~12 tokens.
- Data sensitivity: product catalog contains some merchant PII (contact emails), so we'd like to understand VPC/private deployment options and KMS/HSM support.
- 45 minutes would be ideal.

For timing the two slots on your list, Thu Apr 8 2:00–2:45 PM PDT works best. If possible, include notes on batching and KV-cache strategies — those are big levers for us.

I attached a compact sample of production-like traffic for one endpoint (anonymized).

Looking forward — Samira
[Attachment: shopstack-traffic-sample.csv (csv)]

Great — confirmed. I've scheduled Thu Apr 8, 2:00–2:45 PM PDT and booked Marissa (Solutions). Calendar invite: https://cal.com/averyjohnson/30?slot=2027-04-08T21:00Z (accept will add dial-in).

Quick agenda we'll cover (45m):
- 5m intros and goals
- 15m demo: hosted vs. dedicated routing, latency profiling walkthrough
- 10m ops: autoscaling, KV caching, batching knobs
- 10m security & deployment: VPC/private control plane, KMS options
- 5m next steps: M.A.P. and pilot targets

Pre-reqs to make the session productive: 
- If possible, share a short subset of production prompts or a link to a sample dataset (CSV) — thanks for sending the traffic sample.

Attaching the Mutual Action Plan draft; we'll update timing after the demo if you want to proceed to pilot.

See you Thu — Avery
